findings: Identity audit currently covers 30 listed Rifts O.C.C.s, two Psi-Stalker paths, six dragon hatchlings and their shared rules, ten Heroes Unlimited power categories and two optional modifiers. It does not complete either core book or the 13-book corpus.
Racial choices, breed/path variants, Heroes subpaths, supporting mechanical entries and all supplement identities remain to be audited. Identity evidence does not certify numerical rules.
Unassigned entries require named content-ticket fan-out after the complete option/dependency audit. The existing Vagabond ticket covers only part of its required mechanics.
